picks.editorial_note: UW is leading and supporting four projects under DOE's Genesis Mission, a national AI-for-science initiative spanning 300+ institutions to accelerate scientific discovery — a flagship example of federal government scaling AI research infrastructure across academia.
picks.title: UW researchers lead and support new ‘AI-for-Science’ Genesis Mission awards | UW News

picks.editorial_note: A $10 million OpenAI Foundation grant to Notre Dame (part of a $60 million investment) will bring AI-powered weather and crop-disease forecasting to millions of farmers, a rare case of AI research translating directly into humanitarian-scale real-world impact.
picks.title: AIM for Scale receives $10 million to bring AI-powered weather services to millions of farmers

picks.editorial_note: UNSW's strategic partnership with OpenAI to deploy ChatGPT Edu to over 80,000 students and staff is one of the largest AI-in-education rollouts in the Asia-Pacific region, signaling how quickly major AI vendors are embedding themselves in higher education.
picks.title: UNSW partners with OpenAI to support the first generation of AI natives in the workforce

picks.editorial_note: A $20 million gift establishing the Anuradha and Vikas Sinha College of Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Analytics at UNT reflects the growing trend of major private philanthropy reshaping university AI infrastructure and talent pipelines.
picks.title: UNT receives $20 million gift to advance artificial intelligence, advanced analytics

picks.editorial_note: University of Kentucky's selection for DOE's 'Mine of the Future' initiative shows federal agencies tapping academic-industry teams to apply AI to critical domestic resource extraction and infrastructure challenges.
picks.title: UK selected to help advance DOE ‘Mine of the Future’ initiative

picks.editorial_note: OpenAI's claim to have solved a Millennium Prize math problem — met with public skepticism from UCLA's Terence Tao — is a high-stakes test case for how AI capability claims are verified and reported, with real implications for trust in AI-generated mathematics.
picks.title: OpenAI says it has solved one of math’s 'Millennium Problems' — and more UCLA media

picks.editorial_note: Sandia's ETCRAM analog memory technology achieves 100x density improvements over conventional storage, a hardware advance that could meaningfully change the efficiency calculus for AI-capable edge devices.
picks.title: New analog memory may make smart devices even smarter

picks.editorial_note: USF's unveiling of its new Bellini College of AI, Cybersecurity and Computing building, backed by a $40 million gift, marks a major physical and institutional investment in AI education infrastructure.
picks.title: USF President Limayem announces location, unveils plans for new Bellini College building

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL's InstructMesh, developed with Google and Northeastern, lets users repair and fabricate AI-generated 3D models with real fidelity — a concrete step toward making generative design tools practically usable.
picks.title: New tool lets users repair AI-generated 3D models, then fabricate them just the way they want

picks.editorial_note: The FlexSysAI pilot with CSIRO and University of Queensland to make AI data centre workloads dynamically shiftable across the grid addresses a growing tension between AI's energy demand and grid stability, an increasingly urgent policy and infrastructure issue.
picks.title: Australia-first pilot to transform data centres from static loads into dynamic grid aware assets
